title: CTGAN vs Faker: Comparativo de Geração de Dados Sintéticos
summary: A university seminar project comparing Faker's rule-based data generation against a GAN-based approach for producing synthetic tabular records with preserved correlations, evaluated via correlation and Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistics. It trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (with a SingleTableMetadata object) on a mock salary/credit-score dataset to generate the synthetic comparison data.
needs: Coursework repo with no named authors beyond a discipline/date header; industry classification is generic since dataset is a synthetic demo, not a real domain application.
